environment.fflate: Three bundled official fflate 0.8.2, sync deflate levels 1/6; no new dependency

memory.knownLiveScope: The diagnostic retains up to 1024 production RLE entries under an experiment-only unlimited byte budget so per-image encode/decode can be measured. knownLiveBufferBytes includes those, one raw input/output, row scratch, compressed result, and in the hybrid arm packed/expanded RLE streams. It excludes fflate internal transient buffers, Canvas native backing/Skia storage and JS metadata. Process peaks are sampled after codecs, not in-call allocation peaks or browser memory.

method: All arms use the exact same native-Canvas production paintFigure RGBA, including full transparent padding and alpha-zero RGB, flipped as the production recovery cache expects. Per-image encode once, decode three times into a full domain; every decode timer includes its output allocation. Deflate level 1/6 execution order alternates across samples. Hybrid encode includes measured production RLE encode + packing/deflate of its typed representation. Paint/readback timers include actual Canvas submission/readback but native Node costs are not browser costs. There is no GPU, simulation or engine frame measurement. Size replay never increases the real production recovery budget and does not predict speedups.
